description: Header file defining classes and structures for parsing Mach-O files and fat binaries, including FatReader and Reader classes, along with related data structures and error reporting mechanisms.

classes.name: FatReader
classes.description: Class for parsing fat binary files and extracting object file information.

classes.name: FatReader::Reporter
classes.description: Error reporting class for FatReader, reports issues during fat binary parsing.

classes.name: Segment
classes.description: Represents a segment in a Mach-O file, including its properties and contents.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section within a Mach-O segment, including its properties and contents.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: Class for parsing Mach-O files, providing interfaces for reading headers, segments, and sections.

classes.name: Reader::Reporter
classes.description: Error reporting class for Mach-O parsing issues.

classes.name: Reader::SectionHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling sections during parsing.

classes.name: Reader::LoadCommandHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling load commands during Mach-O parsing.

methods.name: FatReader::Read
methods.description: Reads data as a fat binary or Mach-O file, validating format.

methods.name: FatReader::object_files
methods.description: Returns array of object files in the fat binary.

methods.name: Reader::Read
methods.description: Reads and parses Mach-O data, validating CPU type and subtype.

methods.name: Reader::FindSegment
methods.description: Finds a segment by name within the Mach-O file.

methods.name: Reader::WalkSegmentSections
methods.description: Iterates over sections in a segment, applying a handler.

methods.name: Reader::MapSegmentSections
methods.description: Creates a map of section names to Section objects within a segment.
